units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:7:4">Y. Ber. II, 5ᵇ</cite> <he>רחיצה של ת׳</he> a bath for pleasure; <he>שאינה של ת׳</he> an ordinary cleansing bath.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 8:1:6">Y. Yoma VIII, 44ᵈ</cite>) a. e. <he>סיכה שהיא של ת׳</he> luxurious ointing of the body; <he>שאינה של ת׳</he> common ointing.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 14:3:2">Y. Sabb. XIV, 14ᶜ</cite> <he>אם לת׳</he> if you drink it for the enjoyment of it, contrad. to <he>לרפואה</he> as a medicine.
<cite ref="Eruvin 54a:5">Erub. 54ᵃ</cite> (from Ben Sira) <he>שאין בשאול ת׳ וכ׳</he> there is no pleasure in the nether world, and no delay for death.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 23">Pesik. R. s. 23</cite>, end <he>לא … אלא לת׳</he> the Sabbath has been given to man for enjoyment.
